body:
### Summary

Hello uv folks.

In Fedora, we have triaged several already disclosed CVEs from pypa/virtualenv as they were reported to the uv package as well (reasons not important, happy to explain). With LLM (Claude Sonnet 5) I have found that CVE-2026-113722 is reproducible in uv 0.13.6 on Fedora Linux.

https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/commit/2519941bed33ee0d3ac99277f67913e439e476a9

uv's console-script shebang generator only falls back to the /bin/sh wrapper for paths containing a space or exceeding 127 bytes, not for paths containing a tab, so a venv created under a path with a tab produces console-script launchers the kernel cannot parse.

    mkdir $'tab\tdir'
    uv venv $'tab\tdir/venv'
    uv pip install --python $'tab\tdir/venv/bin/python' <any wheel with a console_scripts entry point>
    $'tab\tdir/venv/bin/<script>'
    # bash: .../venv/bin/<script>: tab: bad interpreter: No such file or directory 

I have reported this to security at astral.sh but this does not constitute vulnerability within uv’s attacker and threat models, hence I am reporting this as a regular bug.

### Platform

Fedora Linux

### Version

0.13.6

### Python version

any
title: Generated POSIX console launchers interpret destination paths as shell syntax
